scripts.bench:browser-report: nix shell nixpkgs#nodejs nixpkgs#chromium -c sh -lc 'CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=$(command -v chromium) bun run bench/browser-runner.ts'
scripts.build: bun run copy-license && bunx tsc --build && chmod +x packages/cli/dist/main.js
scripts.build:clean: bun run clean && bun run build
scripts.copy-license: for dir in packages/*/; do cp LICENSE "$dir"; done
scripts.verify:packages: bun run scripts/verify-package-artifacts.ts && bun run verify:browser
